item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: Cherry Studio 2.2.2
item.description:
Customize your own AI assistant

Cherry Studio is a Windows, Mac, and Linux-compatible desktop client that supports multiple major language model (LLM) providers. It not only integrates cloud services such as OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, but also supports the deployment of Ollama and LM Studio native models. Users can use the built-in 300 + preconfigured AI assistants, or custom create a dedicated assistant to talk to multiple models at the same time and get diverse perspectives. At the same time, the app supports a variety of document formats, including text, pictures, Office, and PDF, with WebDAV file management and data backup capabilities. Cherry Studio also provides useful tools such as global search, topic management, AI-driven translation, and ensures a quality experience with light and dark themes and transparent windows that can be used out of the box without additional configuration. Users who like Cherry Studio can support its development through Little Star or sponsored developers.

item.title: Itsytv 1.8.0
item.description:
Mac Menu Bar Apple TV Remote Control Tool

Itsytv is a native open source app that brings Apple TV remote control to the macOS menu bar for users who need to quickly control their TV, type text, and manage playback status on a Mac. It connects to Apple TV through the same local network protocol as Siri Remote, providing direction keys, confirmation, return, home page, playback pause, and volume control, responding directly and without relying on cloud services. Users can use a compact hover panel for remote control, keyboard navigation with arrow keys, Return, Backspace, Escape, and Spacebar, and enter content in the Apple TV text box in real time. Apps showcase the cover, title, artist, and progress of your current playback, and the built-in app launcher lists installed apps, gets icons, and supports drag-and-drop sorting. Itsytv supports pairing and switching between multiple Apple TVs, automatically starting for different device memory panel locations, setting global shortcuts, and logging in.

item.title: Tinycast 0.12.15
item.description:
Native lightweight all-purpose starter

Tinycast is a native macOS launcher for daily high-frequency operations. Press the global shortcut key to call up the hover panel from any interface, and centralize the application launch, file retrieval, clipboard, calculation conversion, window management and system control into the same portal. The software is implemented with SwiftUI and AppKit. Zero third-party dependencies, no Electron, and no telemetry data are collected. The memory occupancy is usually controlled within 100MB. The launcher supports fuzzy search and favorite sticky. You can view running apps and exit single or all apps. You can also bind a dedicated hotkey for a specific app. Press it once to switch between focusing and hiding. File search directly reuses the system Spotlight, opening files and folders in the folder selected by the user without indexing them yourself. The dictionary function reads the native dictionary and instantly interprets the input entries. Clipboard history overwrites both text and images, allowing you to search and paste back into the app you just used. The calculator performs mathematical operations, unit conversions, and real-time currency-to-cryptocurrency conversions within the panel.

item.title: RClick 2.3.4
item.description:
Open Source Access Right-Click Menu Enhancement Tool

RClick is a Finder context menu enhancement app for macOS, based on Swift 6.2 and SwiftUI, for macOS 15.6 and above, with full support for dark mode and adaptive SF Symbols icons. It uses the dual-process architecture of the main application and the FinderSync extension, and communicates through DistributedNotificationCenter to inject custom actions into the Finder right-click menu. Core features include using any installed app to open files or folders and support custom parameters and environment variables, one-click copy full path to the clipboard, direct permanent deletion to bypass the wastebasket, toggling file hiding status, instant sharing via AirDrop, creating new files in iWork format such as txt json md docx pptx xlsx and pages key numbers from preset templates, and fixing frequently used directories to menus for quick access.

item.title: OpenDisplay 1.30.3
item.description:
Turn your iPhone/iPad into a second screen for your Mac

OpenDisplay is a free, open-source macOS extended display tool that can turn an iPhone, iPad, or even an idle Mac into a second or third screen for your Mac, providing a true extended desktop rather than a simple mirror. The software operates with the Sender on the Mac side and the Receiver on the receiving side, supporting USB wired connections and WiFi connections. The USB mode can reach up to 60FPS, utilizing hardware H. H.264 encoding, low-latency transmission, and an auto-discovery mechanism ensure that the image maintains Retina-level clarity. Users can connect up to three iPhones or iPads simultaneously and freely arrange the displays in the system settings. The device supports touch-based actions such as tapping, dragging, two-finger scrolling, and switching between portrait and landscape modes, making it suitable for use with chat windows, logs, documents, development tools, and other applications. OpenDisplay does not require account registration, subscriptions, intermediary hardware, or the same Apple ID. It supports interconnection between Apple devices belonging to different users, with data transmitted directly between devices without relying on servers or telemetry services. The project uses the GPL-3.0 license and supports self-compilation, code review, and community contributions.

item.title: PasteMemo 1.17.1
item.description:
Lightweight Native Clipboard Manager

PasteMemo is a lightweight, native macOS clipboard manager that runs as a resident menu bar app. It captures everything the user copies and enables instant search and pasting anywhere. The software supports quick panel operations, allowing users to open a feature-rich clipboard workstation via global hotkeys to perform various advanced operations such as searching, filtering by application or group, entering slash commands, pasting text as files, and pasting paths. PasteMemo introduces clipboard automation, allowing users to define rules based on regular expressions, content types, or sources. This enables automatic actions such as cleaning tracking URLs, assigning groups, flagging sensitive content, and removing formatting, making the clipboard work intelligently in the background. The software offers a custom grouping feature, allowing users to manually assign items by right-clicking or automatically categorize them through automation rules. This enables the organized arrangement of code snippets, links, colors, and other content into different groups, with color-coding for easy differentiation.

item.title: Handy 0.10.1
item.description:
Open-source voice input tool

Handy is a free, open-source speech-to-text application that users can run on their own computers and use simple keyboard shortcuts to transcribe speech into text. Simply press the key combination, speak, and then release, and Handy will automatically paste what was said into the text box where the user is typing. The app's settings are very straightforward. The push-to-talk mode, which is enabled by default, allows users to press and hold a key to record. Alternatively, this mode can be disabled, and a simple key combination can be used to start and stop transcription. Handy is mapped to the Ctrl-Z key. When in use, the transcription icon in the top-right corner of the interface will light up. Handy's goal is to make accessibility tools easily available to everyone at no cost, with user data kept entirely locally and not uploaded to the cloud for processing. It is dedicated to providing a simple and easy-to-use tool that focuses on real-time transcription. If you would like to support Handy, you can do so by making a donation, using GitHub Sponsors, or contacting us directly. Handy is a free, open-source speech-to-text application that runs on your computer, providing a simple and efficient voice input experience.

item.title: FlowDown 5.2.10
item.description:
Open-source, multi-model AI chat client

FlowDown is a lightweight AI chat client for macOS and Apple multi-platform users, emphasizing high-speed rendering, a clean interface, privacy controls, and an open ecosystem. It can connect to any service compatible with the OpenAI API and also supports running local models on Apple Silicon devices. It is suitable for integrating cloud-based large models, self-hosted inference services, Ollama, LM Studio, or home lab environments into a single conversation interface. The software supports text, image, and audio input and can be used for code explanation, content summarization, speech transcription, screenshot questioning, knowledge organization, and workflow automation. Markdown rendering makes code blocks, tables, and lists easier to read, and long conversations can also maintain smooth responsiveness. FlowDown does not collect chat data, its code is open-source and transparent, and it offers features such as quick commands, automatic conversation titles, web content retrieval, reminder actions, and iCloud syncing. It is better suited for advanced users who value efficiency, controllable configurations, and a private AI user experience.

item.title: PhotoTransfer 1.2.3
item.description:
Tool for Transferring iPhone Photos to Mac via USB

Photo Transfer is an iPhone and iPad photo import tool for macOS that securely copies photos, videos, Live Photos, and editing-related files to a Mac, external hard drive, or NAS via a USB cable. The software does not require the installation of an app on the phone, nor does it rely on iCloud, Wi-Fi, or the Photos library. The device is opened in read-only mode and will not delete, modify, or write to the phone's content. Before importing, you can preview folders, thumbnails, quantity, and size, and automatically organize directories by date, event, or trip. Custom folder naming rules such as year, month, city, and country are supported. Live Photos, original photos, MOV videos, and AAE editing files will be stored in the same set of folders. Each file undergoes SHA-256 verification, supports resuming transfers after connection loss, copies only new files that do not already exist at the destination, and converts HEIC to JPEG and HEVC to H.264.

item.title: Riffle 2.3.4
item.description:
Native lightweight file Diff tool for macOS

Riffle is a native file diffing and merging tool for macOS developers. Built with Swift, it supports both Apple silicon and Intel Macs and can handle files, folders, images, and Git changes locally. It offers clear two-way diffs, three-way merges with editable results, folder comparisons, and a full Git review window, allowing you to view changes in the working directory, staging area, branches, commit history, and GitHub pull requests. Developers can stage, unstage, and discard changes by file or Git hunk, and they can also view line-by-line blame, file history, and changeset commits alongside the differences. The software supports character-level and word-level highlighting, diff folding, soft wrapping, invisible character display, multi-tab comparison, image pixel inspection, synchronized zooming, and color difference analysis. It comes with 47 built-in languages and 62 themes, and can also import resources from VS Code, Shiki, and TextMate.

In addition, coconutBattery can also send notifications to alert users when the battery level falls below a set percentage or remaining time. item.title: ByteMail 1.9.40

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.description:
Window Arrangement Layout Assistant

Rectangle Pro is an advanced window management tool designed specifically for macOS users, offering superior window management capabilities. Professional Mac Cleaner and Uninstaller

The software supports macOS 10.13 and later versions and is compatible with 64-bit Intel and Apple M-series processors. It can find and delete unnecessary files, including caches, logs, and duplicate documents, preventing residual files left behind after app uninstallation. Users can quickly find duplicate files, manage information about their favorite applications, and check for software updates. Its Smart Mode feature automatically detects apps that have been moved to the Trash and offers a clean uninstall option. TrashMe 3 also features a variety of practical functions such as system monitoring, maintenance tools, and visualized disk usage. It supports dark mode and widget display, making the user experience more convenient and diverse.
